name: USDC/WMON band rebalancer

description.model: Tunes the USDC/WMON band plan: target, band, brake, cost. Use when a Zoom out weighs changing rebalance_bands@1, the two-asset fallback.
description.marketplace: Keeps a target split between USDC and WMON inside bands, with a volatility brake for buys and a cost limit per trade. Tunes the platform's rebalance_bands@1 template; the platform's runner makes the trades.

triggers: reviewing the plan's target WMON share
deciding whether a band, brake or cost limit should move
